properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the ledger-trust and DID-key signature family of this Aries wallet (deadline-class quantum risk, Shor; ML-DSA-65 migration is a network/ecosystem decision for the ledger sites, framework-level for local DID keys). Note: the same genesis strings on these lines also carry BLS12-381 validator state-proof keys (blskey/blskey_pop) — a distinct quantum-vulnerable asset the collector did not detect, filed as its own finding (candy-network genesis, ledgers.json:29).

properties.name: pqs:context
